title: Magnesium oxide (MgO)
method: Lunar Prospector GRS major-oxide weight fraction from gamma-ray spectral unmixing (Prettyman et al. 2006), 5° equal-area pixels (column W_MGO) × 100, rasterised to 0.5° by pixel containment. True resolution ~5° (150 km) at 100 km altitude; bilinear resampling to G1K only smooths.

sources.name: Lunar Prospector GRS Elemental Abundance (LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0)
sources.citation: Prettyman et al. (2006), JGR 111, E12007; Prettyman, NASA PDS (2012)
